title: Correlating ZIA, ZPA and Client Connector logs

prose.text: Following one user or one request across ZIA, ZPA and Client Connector means knowing where each product's logs are, which fields line up, and which field meanings are still open.

steps.label: Where are the logs, and how far back?
steps.text: ZIA's Nanolog and NSS, ZPA's LSS, and Client Connector's device-side logs: [[shared.log-correlation.streams]].

steps.label: Same user or event across the ZIA feeds?
steps.text: Fields shared by web, firewall and DNS records, and which time field to join on: [[shared.log-correlation.zia-feeds]].

steps.label: Was it Client Connector traffic?
steps.text: Forwarding method, tunnel version, device fields and bypass flags in ZIA records: [[shared.log-correlation.zcc-in-zia]].

steps.label: Same request in ZIA and ZPA?
steps.text: No shared key exists; user, device, application segment and time fields, and what is open about each: [[shared.log-correlation.zia-zpa-join]].

steps.label: Writing the query.
steps.text: Field naming in the SIEM and the validation searches: [[shared.splunk]].
